task: Update CodeMie's A2A AgentCard/types, JSON-RPC router dispatch, and CodemieTaskManager to speak A2A protocol spec v1.0 (negotiated value "1.0"), including implementing server-side streaming (currently a dead-code stub), while preserving the discovery-endpoint auth/Ability split and the assistant execution path (server-side only, slice 2 of 4 of EPMCDME-15327).

key_reasoning.reason: Five tightly-coupled components across three layers — wire types (types.py: AgentCard, Task/Message/Part, JSON-RPC envelopes), router dispatch (routers/a2a.py), the TaskManager ABC plus CodemieTaskManager, and the AgentCard-conversion layer (a2a/utils.py) — none of which can change in isolation (Part discriminator removal and method-name renames cascade through all of them), plus a new streaming-transport abstraction and a new dispatch mechanism that don't exist today.

Streaming is genuinely novel (on_send_task_subscribe is a one-line stub; the sibling _handle_a2a_stream is dead, untested code with a latent type mismatch, and no HTTP-streaming transport exists in the router today); the JSON-RPC POST endpoint has zero router-level test coverage and the one existing streaming unit test self-mocks the method under test, so there is no regression baseline for AC7; and the wire-shape rename reshapes what's stored in the JSONB-backed a2a_tasks columns with no read-compat path (PydanticType does a direct model_validate), making previously-persisted rows unreadable post-deploy with no formal migration to fall back on.

Core changes span types.py, routers/a2a.py, server/task_manager.py, server/codemie_task_manager.py, and a2a/utils.py, plus updates to three existing test files (test_a2a_router.py, test_codemie_task_manager.py, test_utils.py) and likely new test coverage for the previously-untested POST dispatch endpoint and streaming path — landing at roughly 8-10 modified files plus 1-2 new across routers/, a2a/, a2a/server/, and their mirrored tests/ directories.

Touches API (router dispatch, discovery path, new streaming response), Service (TaskManager/CodemieTaskManager, AgentCard conversion), and DB-Persistence (Task SQLModel JSONB columns whose stored shape changes significantly) — three layers including a persistence-shape change, matching the persistence-with-schema-change tier even without a formal Alembic migration.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped via streaming/real-time red flag: implementing server-side streaming from a dead-code stub with no existing HTTP-streaming transport pattern in the router.

Technical Risk reinforced via zero-test-coverage red flag: the JSON-RPC POST endpoint has no router-level tests and the existing streaming unit test self-mocks the method under test, so no defensive/edge-case test template covers the new dispatch or streaming work.

Affected Layers/Technical Risk reinforced via database-schema-significant-change red flag: JSONB-persisted Task columns change wire shape with no read-compat path and no migration, creating an irreversible-once-deployed risk for rows written under the old shape.
